limits: Prefix and full weights are supplied; no learned semantic law or compressed model claim.
FP64 NumPy formulas forecast fixed selected vocabulary rows; full-vocabulary greedy token is observed only.
Native dose scales actual FP32 MLP return; rounding residuals against FP64 are retained, not a science gate.
Fresh native prefills own their KV; typed common-parent branches cover the selected suffix only.
Cached continuations are native measurements after first-step edit removal; no future forecast or cache restore claim.
Instrumentation guards ordinary module calls; trusted Python is not an OS isolation boundary.
Genuine native prefixes supply the cut; this is not a raw-token/full-LM forecast.
Only selected fixed vocabulary rows are forecast; full-vocabulary greedy tokens and subsequent text are native observations.
No model, source equations, native replay or tokenizer executed during this saved-array audit.
Checkpoint-to-selected-weight extraction is source-bound worker provenance; full checkpoint numerical tensors are not reloaded by this audit.
Installed HF source SHA inventories are archive-bound worker observations; external installed files are not refetched by this audit.
Same-KV/same-first-token continuation closure is a mechanics diagnostic, not a forecast or independent scientific certification.
